## fingerprint

```yaml
what_it_is: 'Aligns a model trained on a labeled source domain to perform on an unlabeled
  (or differently distributed) target domain.

  '
positive_signals:
- a labeled source and an unlabeled target dataset
- a domain-alignment or self-training objective
- pseudo-label generation, fusion, tracking, or iterative retraining on target data
route_elsewhere:
- signal: the source model is a fixed teacher and the objective is student/teacher
    matching, not target-domain adaptation
  to: TE-TS/knowledge_distillation
- signal: adaptation happens only at inference with no retraining or pseudo-label
    loop
  to: DA-TTA/entropy_minimization_tta
worked_examples:
- ST3D (Yang et al. 2021)
- MS3D / MS3D++ (Tsai et al. 2023/2024)
- Source-free UDA with target pseudo-labels
```
